title: Zindaan mein sogayi hai
body:
Zindañ me soogayi hai beti hussain ki.
Rota tha uska bhai..(2)
Roti rahi phupi...
<<DIVIDER>>
1.  Wo jo rihaai ka tha armaañ huwa na poora
Zanjeer me hi lipta haye janaza uttha
Bachchi ki maut par toh..(2)
rooyi hai maut bhi...
<<DIVIDER>>
2.  Rukhsaar ki musalsal badli hai jiski rangath
Jis par har ek qadam par tooti nayi qayamath
Har pal huwi hai jiski..(2)
Dushwaar zindagi...
<<DIVIDER>>
3.  Bhai ki laadli thi aamu ki jaan thi wo
Thi wo sukoon e sarwar kunbe ki shaan thi wo
Maañ ke liye thi bachchi..(2)
Aankhoñ ki roushni...
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Roone peh pehradaari soone peh pehradaari
Karbobala se le kar zindaañ e shaam bhi
Aashoor ki wo jaagi..(2)
Ek pal na soo saki...
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Baba ka sar jo usne zindaan me hai paya
Kya kya sitam sahe haiñ ehwaal sab sunaya
Ehwaal kehte kehte..(2)
Hai saañs rukgayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Tum ARSALAN dekho kaisi yeh be basi hai
Seene peh soone wali mitti me soogayi hai
Hai qaid me abhi bhi..(2)
Sarwar ki laadli...
